This is the core business of the group, centered on engineer dispatch, providing technology through dispatch and contracting. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥47,925 million (up 4.7% year on year), and operating profit was ¥4,926 million (up 0.9% year on year). The securities report states that technical education in advanced technology and environmental fields was strengthened, that utilization rates were kept at a high level in conjunction with sales measures such as team dispatch, and that contract unit prices also rose.
